title: TCL 60 SE NxtPaper 5G 256GB - Space Grey $197 (50% off) + $7.95 Delivery ($0 C&C/ in-Store) @ Harvey Norman
body:
Deal: TCL 60 SE NxtPaper 5G 256GB - Space Grey $197 (50% off) + $7.95 Delivery ($0 C&C/ in-Store) @ Harvey Norman

[ChristopherJack] Which is which these days? China is making the renewable transition more affordable. The USA is blowing up our petrol prices & flip flopping on almost every bilateral and international agreement we've ever made together.
[iSmart] @ChristopherJack: that's why i said traditional ally. Trump's government won't last forever, they're a democracy like us.
[Murkymerv] @iSmart: Hilarious , democracy that is !
[wintersnow911] "traditional adversary" I've never seen a biggest trading partner classified this way before.
[iSmart] @wintersnow911: why not both. Australia's essentially in the same boat as Japan, South Korea and the EU, with China being their biggest trading partner, as well as risk.
https://www.lowyinstitute.org/the-interpreter/chinese-warshi…
We have trust issues when their warships come unannounced… https://www.nine.com.au/australia-news/chinese-flotilla-sail…
I'm just saying that it is unusual to just start accepting China just because they're our biggest trading partner - their track record has been very patchy against us and our traditional allies in Asia and around the world. We are part of NATO's Indo-Pacific Four, along with Japan, South Korea and New Zealand… because of players like China.
Politics aside, enjoy your new phone.
[shxhshzhz] Nothing CMF Phone 2 Pro $199 is a much better phone with a better processor and longer updates.
This TCL has less than one year of security updates left.
[montorola] Sounds like the NxtPaper will quickly become a PaperWgt?
[Almost Banned] Except it has half the storage and requires you to buy a plan with Amaysim???
[shxhshzhz] Except it has expandable storage with microSD and reading the comments would have shown you that the plan only costs a few dollars. Half the storage doesn't justify a significantly worse phone like this TCL
[BestTechAdvisor] The selling point of the TCL is the screen, not the processor. If you want an eINK phone, this is the best one can currently buy in Australia.
[hollykryten] @BestTechAdvisor: TCL does not offer good Android upgrade support. One Android upgrade if you're lucky. There isn't good after sales support that way. So it may have a better screen but it lacks in other ways.
[shxhshzhz] @hollykryten: It lacks in every other way 😂
[hollykryten] @shxhshzhz: Yes i know about TCL Smartphones and how the hardware is good but the firmware upgrade support sucks as it's either limited or non existent. I used to own the TCL 20 Pro 5G (never got an Android upgrade the whole time), and then later the TCL 50 Pro 5G as i thought i'd try TCL again. That was a bit of a mistake.
I later ended up pawning both to Cashies when i got the ZTE Nubia Z60 Ultra 512GB storage/16GB RAM smartphone from Mobileciti (it's got Android 15 but it's a pretty good China smartphone flagship model).
[notmaroun] @BestTechAdvisor: NXTPAPER isn't eINK, it's just a LCD with extra steps.
[hollykryten] @notmaroun: Yes it's just fake eINK. It's nothing more than an LCD screen which emulates eINK with a screen mode.
[BestTechAdvisor] @hollykryten: Yes, ik. My wording wasn't clear. I should have said "If you want an eINK phone, this is the closest one can currently buy in Australia."
I have actually used the phone and it's great for $200. I'd pick this over the Nothing as I don't care about the more powerful processor, but I do care about the screen and storage, and while I do care about having up to date software, at $200 I'd be buying a new phone after a year anyway and relegate this phone to a spare.
[hollykryten] If you select the black colour option then it gives you a choice to select the 256GB model which is $249. That model is still in stock. But you would get better after sales support with the Android upgrades with the CMF Phone.
However TCL is not known to give great or even good Android upgrade support. With TCL smartphones you only seem to get one Android upgrade if you're lucky. Some times in the past you got no upgrades. The TCL 20 Pro 5G smartphone i had in the past was stuck on Android 11 the whole time and never got offered an Android upgrade. It was a good smartphone hardware wise but it just was awful with Android upgrade support. I ended up pawning that one to Cashies.
[Nivlac] Plus the added benefit of not having to give a dime to Harvey.
[hollykryten] I suppose would you expect eSIM on a smartphone going for around $200?.
[RTX9090Ti] $129 net: https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/961351
[hollykryten] @RTX9090Ti: That price was very unusual to say the least.
[SkyeMG] @hollykryten: The $39 Moto G54 and $19 Samsung A15 I got was more crazy
[Trein] Nextpaper is not eink, but low resolution screen with a matte layer , which nay be the same as just a screen protector
[Navy Blue] HD+ screen and 18W charging is a no go for me.
[Hellcat] Is there any good eink phone. I am keen to try to daily one and see if it helps with my phone addiction
[synonym] I think this is the only one. https://www.amazon.com.au/dp/B0GYX9YSTD
According to this review, it might help https://pausegadget.com/bigme-hibreak-pro-review/
[mrvaluepack] Why get this and be stuck on Android 15 forever when Galaxy A16 or A17 are similarly priced and have 6 guaranteed version upgrades. This phone is only a bargain at $99 or cheaper.
[hollykryten] The CPU in the Samsung Galaxy A16 (Mediatek Helio G99 6 nm) is terrible and so is the A17 (Exynos 1330 5 nm). That's a terrible smartphone when it comes to CPU. Weak as any thing. I think you'll be cursing the day you bought that if you do.
[mrvaluepack] I was referring to A16 5G which has exact same SoC as this.
[hollykryten] Well you just said A16. And the A16 was just a 4G model with a crappy as CPU. If you meant the A16 5G then you needed to say so. In came as Samsung Galaxy A16 (4G model) and Samsung Galaxy A16 5G. Besides the A16 5G is likely to have the Exynos 1330 5 nm CPU which is still a weak CPU. It's entry level weak CPU crap.
[mrvaluepack] @hollykryten: Exynos 1330 is better than the MT 6300.
[hollykryten] @mrvaluepack: Both are crap. I used to have a smartphone with the MT 6300 CPU (TCL 50 Pro 5G) and it struggled like crazy in the weather radar in the BOM app. It stuttered so bad as the CPU was too weak to handle it.
[mrvaluepack] @hollykryten: That's why i mentioned that this is only a good deal if the price was $99 or less.
[hollykryten] @mrvaluepack: I wouldn't buy it if it was $99. Not sure i would touch it even it was free. It's an awful smartphone CPU.
[GordonD] Love those Latitude "interest free" pay it off in 6 months terms.
You pay no "interest". But each month, on a loaned amount of $197, you pay a "credit card fee" of $11.95 EACH MONTH.
